# SystemLens

> Free PC health check for Windows.

SystemLens is an open-source Windows desktop app for local PC and laptop health checks. It shows an overall health score across battery, thermals, storage, CPU/RAM, audio, network, and display. Reports can be exported as JSON, CSV, or PDF.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows x64
- Version: 4.3.0
- License: MIT
- Price: Free
- Author: Mahima Paseda
- Website: https://mahimapaseda.github.io/SystemLens/
- Download: https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens/releases/latest/download/SystemLens-Setup-Windows.exe
- Source: https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens
- Portfolio: https://mahimapaseda.vercel.app/

## Notes

Diagnostics run locally. For die-level CPU package temperatures on some Intel laptops, run as Administrator.
